Results.ReviewText:
I can't say enough about how great this grill is. Unfortunately this review will get lost among all the other 100+ 5-Star reviews, but I have to add my opinion because this grill is so great.
I am an above novice griller.  I'll give an example of what this grill does for me:
Our family is a well-done steak family. Any red in the meat is considered raw to my parents. Before I had my Traaeger, we ate expensive, thick, high quality T-bones and tenderloin steaks, cooked to well-one and beyond, resulting in dry, ruined steaks from my point of view. We usually ate $15 hockey pucks and others thought that was how a well-done steak is.
Now, with my Traeger, our well-done steaks are completely different. I believe it's just about impossible to over-cook anything on a Traeger. I can smoke a steak for 3 hours and then quick sear it and I end up with a masterpiece (for a novice griller). I cook them to well-done (and sometimes beyond) and the steaks are always amazing. They have huge smoke rings, incredibly great flavor, and most importantly they're always still juicy! The same goes for chicken and pork. I can over-cook things by 5, 10, 15 minutes, and no matter what, the food is still juicy.
I can't believe how great this grill is. I recommend it for everyone, no matter your grilling experience, but especially for novice or beginners. You just can't screw it up.

(I added a generic photo I Googled to show some great smoke rings. I can get beautiful, large, colorful rings like that on all my meat without even trying!)
Results.Title: Amazing Grill

I have just recently smoked  an eleven pound prime rib for thanksgiving diner  no fuss just season put it on and insert the probe and your good to go.  No guess work as to whether its done the probe lets you know and its perfect. It was the most tender prime rib I have ever had.  You will nor regret making this purchase!
Results.Title: Best grill I have owned

Results.ReviewText: We've been looking at Treager for several years. Finally made the purchase. We couldn't be happier. The immense number of recipes we get each week are amazing.  The grill makes cooking out everyday a breeze. We don't know why we waited so long.  We look forward to many years of easy meal prep and lots of great memories. Thank you Treager!!!
Results.Title: We Love this Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have had this the Traeger Elite 34 for just over a year now and wanted a full year to test out this unit before posting a comment.  I have purchased a lot of items over the years and from time to time experienced buyers remorse.   I can unequivocally say that there has never been a day since my son's gave me this unit for Father's Day that I have had any regrets.  I smoke briskets turkeys chickens even hamburgers without any issues.  Not only can you smoke but it makes the most flavorful Chateaubriand or Filet Mignon.  There isn't much you can't do on a Traeger.  Great gift for anyone who loves the convenience of a patio grill but desires the full flavor of a pit smoker.
Results.Title: Best Smoker/Grill EVER

Results.ReviewText: Great grill    I have purchased 3 traegers.    Handle is on end with vent  you will get grease on you. When you move grill you have to lift handle end you will hit your ankles.  I had to buy new leg kit with wheels  $170.00 for the handle end.It NEEDS 4 wheels on it from factory.  I suggest trying to move it before buying it you'll find out.
Results.Title: good grill

Results.ReviewText: I hate reviews. They are byass and some (not all) use them as a personal vendetta. I do not write them. HOWEVER I have to tell u about how I feel about my Traeger experience. I recently built an outdoor kitchen and I installed a 42 inch Lynx. I like it but then a month after I built It purchased  a Traeger 22. Now I wish I could return my 4K Lynx cause I never use it. The only complaint that I have with my Traeger is that I didn't purchase the larger model. It is a MUST OWN. My wife loves it cause every weekend I'm cooking something different. I am yet to be disappointed. I should go to work for them because I am such a fan I tell everyone and anyone who will listen. You MUST HAVE ONE IN YOUR BACKYARD front yard tailgate or any place u can fit one. ABSOLUTELY A MUST HAVE.
Results.Title: A MUST OWN

Results.ReviewText: As a BBQ grill it isn't too bad. Regrettably I wanted A smoker. The only way to get that taste with a Traeger is to use Liquid Smoke.  Can't emphasize this enough. There is smoke but NO FLAVOR!!
Results.Title: Smoker?

Results.ReviewText: Let me start out by saying I'm tradionally a stick smoker. With that said. I have used my Treager a couple times now and it works well. My Major complaint is it doesn't leave a smokey taste or smoke ring that I'm use too. I even use the Treager at the smoke setting and still don't get a lot of smoke I'm use too. I would expect the smoking chamber to have smoke in it and see smoke coming out of the smoke stack and I don't see either. Very disappointed in the none existent smoke and smokering. This is what I get for impulse buying.
Results.Title: Works Okay

Results.ReviewText: This was the best investment ever . We cook with it nightly . Love it love it love it .
Results.Title: Trea gear series 22

Results.ReviewText: I recently purchased a Pro series 22 Traeger grill. I've been grilling for about 45 years I grew up in Santa Maria CA and have used almost every type of grill there is. The Traeger has quickly become my favorite grill ever. From easy assembly to quick start up and great temp control it has every feature I need for back yard grilling. I grilled a tri-tip last night and brought it to work for an offic lunch and everyone was impressed. I did have one small problem with assembly my lifting partner dropped his end and bent the hopper cover. New one ordered and received in less than 5 days. I've purchased the best and last grill I will ever need!
Results.Title: VERY IMPRESSED

Results.ReviewText: I've owned charcoal and gas bbqs in the past and thought they were the only options I had. Once I heard about Traeger wood fired  pellet grills I was intrigued and heard nothing but rave reviews about them from their owners.  I bought mine based upon these recommendations and I'm happy I did. I've never had such an easy time cooking food  that's so delicious!  I have become a Traeger evangelist and lifelong customer.
Results.Title: Game changer

Results.ReviewText: This is the best grill I've owned and Traeger is a great company to deal with.  Everything I cook on my Pro 34 comes out juicy and delicious and assembly was quick and simple.  I'm never going back to propane or charcoal!  I had a problem where a couple of parts ended up breaking when my grill flipped over while moving it and Traeger stood behind their product and shipped me replacement parts right away.  They had me cooking again in a few days like it never happened.  You may find a similar grill out there at a lower price but are you really getting a Traeger quality grill or their outstanding service?  My guess is no.   Keep up the good work Traeger I'll be a repeat customer if and when I ever need to replace this grill.
Results.Title: The Best.... PERIOD.

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love my new Traeger!!! As a blogger I am always looking for fun new ways to prepare and create delicious recipes! The traegar has exeeded my expectations and I have made my best meals ever on this grill.
Results.Title: In love

Results.ReviewText: I have used this a bunch of times and used there recipes for use. It makes the food taste so good. Thinking about upgrading to new one. Don't wait to get one its worth it.
Results.Title: Pro Series 22

Results.ReviewText: What isn't to like.  I didn't want any regrets about purchasing a small one and this has many more features than the Elite 34 just do it already.
Results.Title: My first Traeger and an excellent choice

Results.ReviewText: Have wanted one of these smokers for a long time and finally got the 34'. It smokes great have had it for 3 week have used it 6 times and I'm getting better at it each time. Not  bragging lol. It use as a lot of pellets come parred to my friends 22 pro. that's my only complaint.
Results.Title: Smokin
